# U-TIME International Billiards and Sports Bar

> Pool hall and sports bar at 1919 S Havana St, Aurora, CO 80014. 20 tables (16 7ft Diamond bar boxes, 2 9ft Diamonds, a 3-cushion carom table and a 12ft Star Xingpai snooker table), weekly leagues and tournaments, food and drinks served in-house. Phone 720-923-7147. Email utimebilliards@gmail.com. 21+ after 8 PM.

Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Pages
- [Home](https://utimebilliards.com/): this week's leagues and tournaments, tables, FAQ
- [Leagues & Tournaments](https://utimebilliards.com/events.html): APA (Tue, Fri), VNEA/BCA league night (Wed), Ultimate Pool USA (Thu), U-TIME Juniors (Sun 12–2:30 PM); tournaments Thu, Sat, Sun and Mon
- [Tables](https://utimebilliards.com/about.html): table types and rates ($6 per person per hour; weekday special $10 per person, Mon–Thurs open–6 PM)
- [Food & Drinks](https://utimebilliards.com/menu.html)
- [Photos](https://utimebilliards.com/gallery.html)
- [Visit](https://utimebilliards.com/contact.html): hours, directions, parking

## Hours
- Mon–Sat 2:00 PM – 1:30 AM
- Sun 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM

## Reservations
Table bookings are by phone: 720-923-7147.
